events.title: Inquiry sent, no attachments
events.subject: Manufacturing opportunities - candidate based in Morocco
events.body:
Dear Elran Human Resources Team,

Your careers page describes leather cutting, sewing, upholstery and furniture assembly. My experience includes leather cutting, hand and machine sewing, assembly, finishing and upholstery work in Moroccan workshops.

I am a Moroccan national currently living in Morocco. I do not have Canadian residence or work authorization. My current French and English levels are A2.

Do you consider candidates based outside Canada for full-time cutting, sewing or upholstery positions? If so, could you identify a suitable current role, its work location, weekly hours, wage range and language requirements?

Could you also confirm whether Elran can support the required employer-side immigration process for that role, including an LMIA and Quebec requirements where applicable, or identify any applicable exemption? I would relocate only after the required authorizations and visa are approved.

This is an eligibility inquiry, with no attachments. I can provide my CV and work portfolio through your preferred recruitment channel if there is a suitable opportunity.

Kind regards,
Mohammed Fadil
mfadil.med@gmail.com
